adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces the old PATCH-based incremental membership tests (including “succeeds silently when removing non-members”) with new controller actions `add_members` / `remove_member` and new specs. In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the implementation unconditionally does `group.users.delete(user_id)` and then returns `success_json` if `group.save` succeeds, even if `user_id` was not in the group. The updated spec’s `.remove_member` context only covers (1) automatic group guard (422) and (2) removing an actual member; there is no test asserting behavior when removing a non-member (stale list / already removed). That’s a concrete, diff-grounded coverage gap for the new endpoint behavior rather than a proven functional bug.
